_doc: Slide-2 exec-summary / thesis. DISTILLED from the partner proposal; proposal is source of truth.
positioning: commerce and concierge logistics, now on the water
thesis: The UAE’s waterfront demand is dense, premium, and app-native. Noon can make the marine leg feel as normal as delivery.
the_deal: Launch a Noon-visible foiling water layer across UAE marina, island, resort, and event districts: premium customer movement, high-value courier hops, hotel/concierge bundles, and experience logistics routed through the same app surface Noon already owns.
